objective: Improve reciprocal geometric-mean latency across 28 frozen cases spanning six mixed literal, regex, Unicode, ignore-file, no-match, and many-small-file ripgrep search categories. Exact stdout, stderr, and exit-result hashes, relevant cargo tests, and whole-process-tree peak memory (cgroup2 memory.peak) within a sealed ceiling are hard gates. Only crates/searcher/src, crates/regex/src, and crates/ignore/src are mutable.

meta.provenance: Current-head OSS-T02 capsule from BurntSushi/ripgrep 227381db0ee83dfa4341f1e27ff9617c0f5ad992. Deterministic frozen corpora sha256:9bbe113734c15b3ba19852297be7fab25e05cc84202b6ab7fc52d8fa81f472ff (train) and sha256:72105b465a54f255132c7835b1091418bf86bcd4b30bdb98c814b3655903b868 (validation) are measured through the pinned upstream benchsuite API with no privileged winning patch. Round-4 hardening: fresh /tmp+/var/tmp+/dev/shm tmpfs + CLONE_NEWIPC per invocation, and whole-process-tree memory via a per-invocation cgroup2 memory.peak leaf (replaces wait4 ru_maxrss). Interleaved A-A qBase=0.017953333, sigma=0.000359648; qReference=qBase+max(5*sigma,0.05*abs(qBase-qFail))=0.019751573. Local Docker Desktop numbers are provisional pending frozen GCE recalibration.
